title: Director of Sales

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: This role leads Roland DGA's sales organization that sells directly to sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap shops, large-format print companies, and architectural graphics producers—the exact end-users of Tedlar films. Given Roland's active presence at PRINTING United, ISA Sign Expo, and Impressions Expo with live vehicle wrap demonstrations, the Director of Sales would immediately recognize Tedlar as a powerful sales enablement tool. They would care about: (1) Arming sales reps with a compelling TCO story—customers who buy Roland printers + Tedlar overlaminates achieve 12-20 year graphic lifespans vs. 3-4 years with standard laminates, drastically reducing replacement costs and maintenance, (2) Converting price-sensitive prospects to premium buyers by demonstrating superior long-term value and ROI, (3) Reducing warranty claims and customer service escalations related to outdoor durability failures, which consume sales team time and erode customer trust, and (4) Cross-selling and upselling opportunities within Roland's existing customer base of 150+ employees serving North and South America. Their revenue targets, customer acquisition costs, and win-rate metrics would directly benefit from a Tedlar partnership that strengthens Roland's competitive positioning in outdoor durable graphics.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: As Director of Sales, [Name] leads the sales organization responsible for Roland DGA's $119.4M revenue across North and South America. They manage a team selling TrueVIS, VersaCAMM, and VersaOBJECT wide-format printers to sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and large-format print shops. This role owns revenue targets, sales enablement strategy, customer acquisition metrics, and competitive win rates. They likely report to a VP/SVP of Sales or Chief Revenue Officer and directly manage regional sales managers and territory reps. Their decisions influence which media and consumables get recommended alongside printer sales, affecting both initial deal size and customer lifetime value.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: For Roland's sales organization, Tedlar overlaminates represent three immediate opportunities: (1) Vehicle wraps and fleet graphics—Roland's TrueVIS printers with TR2 inks deliver 3-4 years outdoor durability, but wrapping a fleet with Tedlar protection extends that to 12-20+ years, dramatically improving ROI for fleet operators and transportation companies who are price-sensitive to replacement cycles, (2) Outdoor signage and durable graphics—Roland customers producing outdoor signs, building wraps, and architectural graphics face warranty claims when graphics fade or crack prematurely; Tedlar eliminates UV degradation and reduces customer service escalations that tie up sales team resources, (3) Premium differentiation in competitive deals—when competing against Mimaki, HP Latex, and Epson on similar printer specs, Roland reps can position Tedlar as a bundled solution that delivers measurably superior total cost of ownership, converting price-focused buyers to value-focused buyers and improving close rates on higher-margin deals.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name] is measured on revenue growth, sales team quota attainment, customer acquisition cost, and win rate against competitors. Their personal success depends on: (1) Equipping sales reps with differentiated value propositions that justify premium pricing—Tedlar provides a quantifiable performance advantage (3-5x lifespan extension) that moves conversations from price to ROI, (2) Reducing customer churn caused by durability failures—when Roland customers experience fading, cracking, or UV damage on outdoor graphics, it damages Roland's brand reputation and reduces referrals and repeat purchases, (3) Expanding deal size through cross-selling—adding Tedlar overlaminates to printer sales increases average deal value and improves sales efficiency metrics, (4) Accelerating sales cycles—customers concerned about long-term performance can be shown concrete data on Tedlar's proven 60+ year track record, reducing decision friction. Warranty claim reduction directly impacts [Name]'s team productivity, as sales reps spend less time managing post-sale issues and more time on new customer acquisition.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Roland DGA is actively engaged in the market right now: (1) They exhibited at PRINTING United Expo 2024 in Las Vegas and have confirmed booth presence at PRINTING United 2025 in Orlando, providing immediate opportunities to discuss Tedlar integration at upcoming industry events, (2) They conducted high-visibility live vehicle wrap demonstrations (Tesla Cybertruck at PRINTING United 2024, NASCAR wrap at ISA 2024), indicating the sales team is actively focused on outdoor durability messaging and vehicle graphics applications—exactly where Tedlar adds maximum value, (3) Recent product launches including TrueVIS VG3/SG3 series and EU-1000MF UV flatbed suggest the sales team is onboarding new product lines and could incorporate Tedlar into go-to-market strategies for these platforms, (4) Roland's 3M MCS and Avery Dennison ICS warranty certifications create a natural entry point—positioning Tedlar as enhancing these existing certifications rather than replacing them makes adoption easier for the sales organization.

personalization_hooks.hook: Roland's TrueVIS printers certified for 3-4 years outdoor durability, while competitors make similar claims—no clear differentiation in crowded trade show environments
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Open by acknowledging the competitive landscape at PRINTING United and ISA where Roland competes on similar durability specs. Position Tedlar as the sales enablement tool that lets Roland reps say '12-20+ years' instead of '3-4 years'—a stark, memorable differentiation that wins deals. Frame this as solving [Name]'s win-rate challenge against Mimaki and HP Latex.

personalization_hooks.hook: Live vehicle wrap demonstrations at PRINTING United 2024 and ISA 2024 show Roland's sales strategy emphasizes outdoor graphics applications where Tedlar delivers maximum impact
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference their recent Tesla Cybertruck and NASCAR wrap demonstrations as proof that outdoor durability is already a sales priority. Suggest Tedlar transforms those demos from '3-4 year lifespan' stories into '12-20+ year lifespan' stories—dramatically strengthening ROI conversations with fleet operators and transportation graphics buyers who care about replacement costs.

personalization_hooks.hook: As sales leader for 150+ person organization serving sign shops, wrap installers, and print companies across Americas, [Name] likely faces customer service escalations when outdoor graphics fail prematurely
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Lead with empathy about warranty claims and post-sale issues that consume sales team productivity. Position Tedlar as reducing these escalations by eliminating UV degradation, fading, and cracking—letting the sales team focus on new customer acquisition instead of damage control. Frame as improving sales efficiency metrics and customer retention rates.

recommended_approach: Lead with sales enablement angle—position Tedlar as the competitive differentiation tool that helps Roland's sales team win deals against Mimaki, HP Latex, and Epson by offering measurably superior total cost of ownership. Emphasize the quantifiable lifespan extension (3-4 years to 12-20+ years) as a simple, powerful message that sales reps can use in trade show conversations and customer presentations. Reference Roland's active trade show presence and vehicle wrap demonstrations to show you understand their current sales priorities, then connect Tedlar to making those priorities more successful.
